import sys

def main():
    data = sys.stdin.read().split()
    if not data:
        return
    idx = 0
    n = int(data[idx]); idx += 1
    inorder = list(map(int, data[idx:idx+n])); idx += n
    postorder = list(map(int, data[idx:idx+n])); idx += n
    
    if n == 0:
        print("")
        return
    
    # Build position map for inorder
    pos = {val: i for i, val in enumerate(inorder)}
    
    preorder = []
    
    def build(post_l, post_r, in_l, in_r):
        if post_l > post_r or in_l > in_r:
            return
        root_val = postorder[post_r]
        preorder.append(root_val)
        root_in = pos[root_val]
        left_size = root_in - in_l
        # left subtree: post_l to post_l + left_size - 1, in_l to root_in - 1
        build(post_l, post_l + left_size - 1, in_l, root_in - 1)
        # right subtree: post_l + left_size to post_r - 1, root_in + 1 to in_r
        build(post_l + left_size, post_r - 1, root_in + 1, in_r)
    
    build(0, n - 1, 0, n - 1)
    print(' '.join(map(str, preorder)))

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
